usedFor: Audioscrape turns hosted audio into searchable transcripts, and “Upload Audio From URL” queues each file for transcription.

bestTemplate.name: “Upload Audio From URL” in Audioscrape
bestTemplate.why: It uploads a hosted audio file into a dataset and queues it for transcription.

watchOut: “Upload Audio From URL” needs a hosted audio link, so check each record carries a working one.
